pass: Orders a withdrawal or holds the line; does not order the storm and does not go after the two himself. Speaks of the two fighters with respect, calmly, without rage. Saying he must grow stronger, or putting Lise first, is a plus; running himself down is a plus.

self.label: a pale man with long black hair in a ponytail, red eyes, a butler's coat under a commander's black cloak, a fresh cut across his cheek
self.name: Corin

beliefs.label: his lieutenant, a burly demon officer in black plate

earlier: Corin is now Commander of the Fourth Demon Army, and still the butler and guardian of young Lise, who serves in the army too.

He has just fought two young human fighters, Kiro and Asha, at the fortress gate. They are far weaker than him but fought well together, and one of them cut his cheek. Long ago, on orders, he destroyed the village that sheltered them, and they hate him for it.
The day's goal was only to test the fortress.

dialogue.spoken: Commander, you're bleeding! Those two brats marked you! Give the word and we storm the gate and drag them out by the hair!
